resetHighWaterMark(address).details: SECURITY: This function is intended to be used by governance to onboard a new manager without penalizing them for the previous manager's performance.If a manager is replaced while the strategy is below its previous HWM, the new manager would otherwise inherit a "loss" state and be unable to earn performance fees until the fee config are updated after the week timelock.Calling this function resets the HWM to the current PPS, allowing a newly appointed manager to start from aThis function is only callable by SUPER_GOVERNOR
